agent_initialize_instructions: Use human keys (e.g. KAN, KAN-142, @handle). Pass identifier='help' (or project='help' on create_ticket) for live project options. On create_ticket, set 'project' and optional 'parent' on the root object only; omit 'project' and 'parent' inside children[].

project.description: Project ref (root only; inherited by children)

parent.description: Parent issue ref (root only; omit in children)

children.description: Child sub-issues (inherit root project and enclosing parent; omit project and parent)

validation_failed_child_project_raw_yaml:
error:
  code: VALIDATION_FAILED
  message: Parameter 'project' is only allowed on the root ticket
  hint: Omit 'project' inside children[]; child issues automatically inherit the root project.
  fix_hint: Omit 'project' inside children[]; child issues automatically inherit the root project.
  cli_example: kanban-cli-agent create_ticket --project=KAN --summary="<summary>"
validation_failed_child_parent_raw_yaml:
error:
  code: VALIDATION_FAILED
  message: Parameter 'parent' is only allowed on the root ticket
  hint: Omit 'parent' inside children[]; each child's parent is its enclosing node in children[].
  fix_hint: Omit 'parent' inside children[]; each child's parent is its enclosing node in children[].
  cli_example: kanban-cli-agent create_ticket --project=KAN --summary="<summary>"

tool: create_ticket
project: KAN
params:

  summary: str
